from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its cause of action"""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The officially recorded cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Excerpt from the document showing the cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
